visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A male presenter with glasses and a black button-down shirt stands in a bright studio. A colorful green and orange parrot is perched on his head. Large yellow and white Chinese subtitles appear at the top and bottom of the frame. He uses active hand gestures to emphasize his points. (2) The visual switches to a technical scientific diagram showing 'Nuptial gift giving' in fruit flies. It includes microscopic photos of proboscis extension and a phylogenetic tree. Subtitles continue to flow at the bottom against a semi-transparent background to clarify terminology. (3) A 3D animation of a blue DNA double helix rotates on screen while text overlays like 'fruitless' and 'fru' appear. The background remains clean and focused on the graphic content. The presenter occasionally returns in a split-screen or inset format to narrate. (4) Green fluorescent microscopic images of fruit fly brain neurons are shown in a grid layout. The diagrams illustrate apical dendrites and axon terminals with precise scientific labels. Quick cuts between graphics and the presenter maintain a high visual energy and educational pace.
